chat_player_battle_source:
SELECT facts.snapshot_date,
       facts.player_key,
       facts.player_index,
       facts.detail_index,
       facts.user_id,
       facts.role_id,
       facts.game_seq,
       facts.game_time_label,
       facts.game_time_epoch,
       facts.hero_name,
       facts.map_name,
       facts.map_type,
       facts.star_after_game,
       facts.peak_grade_after,
       facts.peak_grade_before,
       facts.kill_count,
       facts.death_count,
       facts.assist_count,
       facts.result,
       facts.game_grade,
       facts.duration_seconds,
       raw_record.params,
       raw_record.others,
       raw_record.payload AS record_payload,
       facts.record_source,
       facts.is_official,
       facts.participant_index,
       facts.player_camp,
       facts.player_hero_id,
       facts.player_gold,
       participant.payload AS participant_payload,
       facts.game_type,
       detail.payload AS battle_payload
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_facts AS facts
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_records AS raw_record
  ON raw_record.snapshot_date = facts.snapshot_date
 AND raw_record.player_index = facts.player_index
 AND raw_record.detail_index = facts.detail_index
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_participants AS participant
  ON participant.game_seq = facts.game_seq AND participant.participant_index = facts.participant_index
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_details AS detail ON detail.game_seq = facts.game_seq
chat_player_snapshots:
SELECT snapshot.snapshot_date,
       snapshot.player_key,
       snapshot.nickname,
       snapshot.rank_name,
       snapshot.rank_star,
       snapshot.star,
       snapshot.star_up,
       snapshot.today_num,
       snapshot.total_num,
       snapshot.visible,
       snapshot.map_count,
       snapshot.peak_up,
       snapshot.gaming_info,
       snapshot.payload,
       snapshot.updated_at
FROM hok.history_players AS snapshot
chat_personal_snapshots:
WITH tracked AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (player.snapshot_date, player.user_id)
           player.snapshot_date, player.user_id, player.player_key
    FROM hok.history_players AS player
    ORDER BY player.snapshot_date, player.user_id, player.player_index DESC
), configured AS (
    SELECT snapshot.snapshot_date, snapshot.user_id, MIN(player.player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.personal_snapshots AS snapshot
    JOIN hok.chat_configured_players AS player
      ON player.user_id = snapshot.user_id
     AND (player.role_id = snapshot.target_role_id
          OR ((snapshot.target_role_id IS NULL OR player.role_id IS NULL)
              AND player.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM hok.chat_configured_users)))
    GROUP BY snapshot.snapshot_date, snapshot.user_id
)
SELECT snapshot.snapshot_date,
       COALESCE(tracked.player_key, configured.player_key) AS player_key,
       snapshot.invisible,
       snapshot.is_gaming,
       snapshot.battle_count,
       snapshot.payload,
       snapshot.updated_at
FROM hok.personal_snapshots AS snapshot
LEFT JOIN tracked ON tracked.snapshot_date = snapshot.snapshot_date AND tracked.user_id = snapshot.user_id
LEFT JOIN configured ON configured.snapshot_date = snapshot.snapshot_date AND configured.user_id = snapshot.user_id
chat_player_battles:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.record_source,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_label,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.star_after_game,
       battle.peak_grade_after,
       battle.peak_grade_before,
       battle.kill_count,
       battle.death_count,
       battle.assist_count,
       battle.result,
       battle.game_grade,
       battle.duration_seconds,
       battle.player_camp,
       battle.player_hero_id,
       battle.player_gold,
       battle.participant_payload,
       CASE LOWER(battle.participant_payload -> 'battleStats' ->> 'mvp') WHEN 'true' THEN TRUE WHEN '1' THEN TRUE WHEN 'false' THEN FALSE WHEN '0' THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END AS is_mvp,
       battle.game_type
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
chat_player_equipment:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.record_source,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.result,
       battle.game_grade,
       battle.player_camp,
       equipment.ordinality::integer AS equipment_index,
       equipment.value ->> 'equipName' AS equipment_name,
       equipment.value AS equipment_payload
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(battle.participant_payload -> 'battleRecords' -> 'finalEquips', '[]'::jsonb)
) WITH ORDINALITY AS equipment(value, ordinality)
chat_player_battle_roster:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.record_source,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name AS player_hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.result AS player_result,
       battle.game_grade AS player_game_grade,
       battle.player_camp,
       CASE
           WHEN participant.participant_index = battle.participant_index OR participant.role_id = battle.role_id THEN 'self'
           WHEN participant.camp IS NOT DISTINCT FROM battle.player_camp THEN 'teammate'
           ELSE 'opponent'
       END AS relation,
       tracked_participant.player_key AS participant_player_key,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.role_name,
       participant.hero_id,
       participant.hero_name,
       participant.kill_count,
       participant.death_count,
       participant.assist_count,
       participant.game_grade,
       participant.gold,
       CASE LOWER(participant.payload -> 'battleStats' ->> 'mvp') WHEN 'true' THEN TRUE WHEN '1' THEN TRUE WHEN 'false' THEN FALSE WHEN '0' THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END AS is_mvp,
       participant.payload -> 'battleRecords' ->> 'position' AS position,
       participant.payload -> 'battleRecords' -> 'skill' AS skill,
       participant.payload -> 'battleStats' AS battle_stats
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
JOIN hok.battle_participants AS participant ON participant.game_seq = battle.game_seq
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT tracked.game_seq, tracked.participant_index, MIN(tracked.player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS tracked
    GROUP BY tracked.game_seq, tracked.participant_index
) AS tracked_participant
    ON tracked_participant.game_seq = participant.game_seq
   AND tracked_participant.participant_index = participant.participant_index
chat_battle_power_players:
WITH configured AS (
    SELECT participant.game_seq, participant.participant_index, MIN(player.player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.battle_power_players AS participant
    JOIN hok.chat_configured_players AS player
      ON (player.role_id = participant.role_id
          AND (player.user_id IS NULL OR participant.user_id IS NULL OR player.user_id = participant.user_id))
      OR (player.user_id = participant.user_id
          AND player.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM hok.chat_configured_users)
          AND (player.role_id IS NULL OR participant.role_id IS NULL))
    GROUP BY participant.game_seq, participant.participant_index
), tracked AS (
    SELECT game_seq, role_id, MIN(player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.chat_recorded_battle_source
    GROUP BY game_seq, role_id
)
SELECT power.game_seq,
       COALESCE(configured.player_key, tracked.player_key) AS player_key,
       power.map_name,
       power.evaluated_at,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.nickname,
       participant.side,
       participant.hero_name,
       participant.hero_power,
       participant.hero_win_rate,
       participant.hero_average_score,
       participant.single_level,
       participant.payload AS participant_payload,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_level
       END AS participant_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_level
       END AS rival_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
       END AS participant_side_tier,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_tier
       END AS rival_side_tier,
       CASE
           WHEN participant.side = 'my' THEN power.game_result
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '胜利' THEN '失败'
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '失败' THEN '胜利'
           ELSE power.game_result
       END AS participant_result
FROM hok.battle_power AS power
JOIN hok.battle_power_players AS participant ON participant.game_seq = power.game_seq
LEFT JOIN tracked ON tracked.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND tracked.role_id = participant.role_id
LEFT JOIN configured ON configured.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND configured.participant_index = participant.participant_index
chat_hero_rank_entries:
SELECT entry.snapshot_date,
       entry.rank_id,
       snapshot.title,
       snapshot.update_time,
       snapshot.sort_field,
       snapshot.sort_type,
       snapshot.filter_data,
       entry.rank_index,
       entry.hero_id,
       entry.hero_name,
       entry.hero_career,
       entry.tier_rank,
       entry.ban_rate,
       entry.show_rate,
       entry.win_rate,
       entry.pick_count,
       entry.ban_count,
       entry.payload
FROM hok.hero_rank_entries AS entry
JOIN hok.hero_rank_snapshots AS snapshot
  ON snapshot.snapshot_date = entry.snapshot_date
 AND snapshot.rank_id = entry.rank_id
chat_configured_players: SELECT NULL::text AS player_key, NULL::bigint AS user_id, NULL::bigint AS role_id WHERE FALSE
chat_recorded_battle_source:
SELECT latest.snapshot_date,
       latest.player_key,
       latest.player_index,
       latest.detail_index,
       latest.user_id,
       latest.role_id,
       latest.game_seq,
       latest.game_time_label,
       latest.game_time_epoch,
       latest.hero_name,
       latest.map_name,
       latest.map_type,
       latest.star_after_game,
       latest.peak_grade_after,
       latest.peak_grade_before,
       latest.kill_count,
       latest.death_count,
       latest.assist_count,
       latest.result,
       latest.game_grade,
       latest.duration_seconds,
       raw_record.params,
       raw_record.others,
       raw_record.payload AS record_payload,
       'battle_record'::text AS record_source,
       latest.is_official,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.camp AS player_camp,
       participant.hero_id AS player_hero_id,
       participant.gold AS player_gold,
       participant.payload AS participant_payload,
       detail.game_type,
       detail.payload AS battle_payload
FROM hok.chat_battle_record_keys AS latest
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_records AS raw_record
  ON raw_record.snapshot_date=latest.snapshot_date
 AND raw_record.player_index=latest.player_index
 AND raw_record.detail_index=latest.detail_index
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT participant_row.participant_index, participant_row.camp,
           participant_row.hero_id, participant_row.gold, participant_row.payload
    FROM hok.battle_participants AS participant_row
    WHERE participant_row.game_seq = latest.game_seq
      AND participant_row.role_id = latest.role_id
    ORDER BY participant_row.participant_index
    LIMIT 1
) AS participant ON true
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_details AS detail ON detail.game_seq = latest.game_seq
chat_configured_battle_participants:
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT configured.player_key, participant.*
    FROM hok.chat_configured_players AS configured
    JOIN hok.battle_participants AS participant ON configured.role_id = participant.role_id
    WHERE configured.user_id IS NULL OR participant.user_id IS NULL OR configured.user_id = participant.user_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT configured.player_key, participant.*
    FROM hok.chat_configured_players AS configured
    JOIN hok.battle_participants AS participant ON configured.user_id = participant.user_id
    JOIN hok.chat_configured_users AS unambiguous ON unambiguous.user_id = configured.user_id
    WHERE configured.role_id IS NULL OR participant.role_id IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (matched.player_key, matched.game_seq) matched.*
FROM matches AS matched
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT game_seq FROM hok.chat_recorded_battle_source) AS available
  ON available.game_seq = matched.game_seq
ORDER BY matched.player_key, matched.game_seq, matched.participant_index
chat_configured_users:
SELECT user_id
FROM hok.chat_configured_players
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(role_id, 0)) = 1
chat_battle_record_keys:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_record.player_key, raw_record.game_seq)
           raw_record.snapshot_date,
           raw_record.player_key,
           raw_record.player_index,
           raw_record.detail_index,
           raw_record.user_id,
           raw_record.role_id,
           raw_record.game_seq,
           raw_record.game_time_label,
           raw_record.game_time_epoch,
           raw_record.hero_name,
           raw_record.map_name,
           raw_record.map_type,
           raw_record.star_after_game,
           raw_record.peak_grade_after,
           raw_record.peak_grade_before,
           raw_record.kill_count,
           raw_record.death_count,
           raw_record.assist_count,
           raw_record.result,
           raw_record.game_grade,
           raw_record.duration_seconds,
           raw_record.map_name ~ '(排位|巅峰|战队)'
               AND raw_record.map_name !~* '(1v1|2v2|3v3)' AS is_official
    FROM hok.battle_records AS raw_record
    WHERE raw_record.game_seq IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY raw_record.player_key, raw_record.game_seq,
             raw_record.snapshot_date DESC, raw_record.player_index DESC, raw_record.detail_index DESC
chat_player_battle_facts:
WITH games AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (game_seq)
    *
  FROM hok.chat_recorded_battle_source
  ORDER BY
    game_seq,
    (
      game_time_epoch IS NOT NULL
    ) DESC,
    (
      player_camp IS NOT NULL AND result IN ('胜利', '失败')
    ) DESC NULLS LAST,
    snapshot_date DESC,
    player_key
)
SELECT
  recorded.snapshot_date,
  recorded.player_key,
  recorded.player_index,
  recorded.detail_index,
  recorded.user_id,
  recorded.role_id,
  recorded.game_seq,
  recorded.game_time_label,
  recorded.game_time_epoch,
  recorded.hero_name,
  recorded.map_name,
  recorded.map_type,
  recorded.star_after_game,
  recorded.peak_grade_after,
  recorded.peak_grade_before,
  recorded.kill_count,
  recorded.death_count,
  recorded.assist_count,
  recorded.result,
  recorded.game_grade,
  recorded.duration_seconds,
  recorded.record_source,
  recorded.is_official,
  recorded.participant_index,
  recorded.player_camp,
  recorded.player_hero_id,
  recorded.player_gold,
  recorded.game_type
FROM hok.chat_recorded_battle_source AS recorded
UNION ALL
SELECT
  game.snapshot_date,
  participant.player_key,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS player_index,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS detail_index,
  participant.user_id,
  participant.role_id,
  participant.game_seq,
  game.game_time_label,
  game.game_time_epoch,
  participant.hero_name,
  game.map_name,
  game.map_type,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS star_after_game,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS peak_grade_after,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS peak_grade_before,
  participant.kill_count,
  participant.death_count,
  participant.assist_count,
  CASE
    WHEN participant.camp IS NULL OR game.player_camp IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    WHEN NOT game.result IN ('胜利', '失败')
    THEN NULL
    WHEN participant.camp = game.player_camp
    THEN game.result
    WHEN game.result = '胜利'
    THEN '失败'
    WHEN game.result = '失败'
    THEN '胜利'
  END AS result,
  participant.game_grade,
  game.duration_seconds,
  CAST('battle_participant' AS TEXT) AS record_source,
  game.is_official,
  participant.participant_index,
  participant.camp AS player_camp,
  participant.hero_id AS player_hero_id,
  participant.gold AS player_gold,
  game.game_type
FROM hok.chat_configured_battle_participants AS participant
JOIN games AS game
  ON game.game_seq = participant.game_seq
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_recorded_battle_source AS existing
  ON existing.player_key = participant.player_key
  AND existing.game_seq = participant.game_seq
WHERE
  existing.game_seq IS NULL
